note: The walker's kit and the Walker page (Matt's mock and the plan approved October 26, 2026; src/world/kit, src/ui/walker-page.js). slots: the four kit slots down the page's left (hat, lantern, in hand, coat), each with its owned choices popping out beside it; the carrier is the strap above the pouches with the same pop-out. items: per slot, each thing's name, the walker's words about it (Fraunces italic on the bottom card) and its drawn icon (src/ui/icons). A choice not yet owned is a blank outline and is never named; popSlots: how many outlines a pop-out shows at least. belt: the tools that hang on the walker and never use a pouch, in order (shovel, knife, fire steel, sketchbook, the net): an unowned one is a blank outline. The carrier changes at camp only (where the others hang); campOnly is the line elsewhere. hollow: Q and E stay hidden until the Hollow is found. page: widest the page draws (px) and the width below which the pouches move under the walker. portrait: the walker drawn in its own small view while the page is open: px its longer side at most (device pixels; the box's own size below that), idleTurnDegS the slow turn (degrees a second) while nobody drags, dragDegPerPx how far a drag turns it, settleS how long after a drag before the slow turn resumes, camera its distance, height and field of view (degrees), light the key light's direction and colour and the sky fill (linear), exposure into the tonemap. figure: the hat and coat looks for Phase 4 dyes (null: as made).

own.name: Your hat
own.line: Wide enough to keep the rain off a sketch. The brim has gone soft at the front where I pull it down.

hand.name: Hand lantern
hand.line: It hangs on the tent pole by day. After dark I take it with me when I leave the camp.

stick.name: Hazel walking stick
stick.line: A step further, across a ditch or shallow water.

own.name: Your coat
own.line: Patched at both elbows and longer than it needs to be. The pockets still smell of the boat.

pack.name: Your first pack
pack.line: Six cloth pouches on a strap.

satchel.name: Rush satchel
satchel.line: Plaited rushes on a cord strap. Eight pouches.

basket.name: Willow basket
basket.line: Woven withies on two cord straps. Ten pouches.

lantern.name: No lantern
lantern.line: Left on the tent pole. The camp keeps its light.

hand.name: Empty hands
hand.line: Nothing in hand. Room for whatever I find.

_bands: Hat bands (docs/future/15 slice 2b): worn in the band of whatever hat is worn (the hen's feather: recipes/species/hen.json fond.feather.onHat), always worn once given; worn: the words the hat's card adds on the Walker page.

hen-feather.name: Hen-feather band
hen-feather.worn: Tucked into the band, one of the hen's barred tail feathers. She left it by the fire for me.

belt.name: Shovel
belt.line: A stick, a flat stone and cord, bound tight. It hangs on the pack.

belt.name: Gathering knife
belt.line: A clean cut leaves a plant less bare, and it is ready again sooner.

belt.name: Fire steel
belt.line: Steel and flint in a small pouch of their own. Three strikes, most evenings.

belt.name: Sketchbook
belt.line: Charcoal and a book of rough paper. The hand gets surer with every page.

belt.name: Net
belt.line: A hand net on a short pole, for the shallows.

words.title: The Walker
words.campOnly: The other carriers hang at camp. Change it there.
words.pick: Choose a slot, a pouch or a tool to see it here.

figure.note: Hat and coat looks for Phase 4 dyes: per id, a linear tint [r, g, b] for that part (null: as made). Read by src/world/kit/model.js looksOf; the walker's own are as made.
